title: Brands — Content

fields.message: Brands — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
fields.default_value: Two brands. One standard. Zero compromises.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_sub
fields.instructions: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
fields.default_value: Every BRG location is built on the same foundation: quality ingredients, genuine hospitality, and a laid-back vibe worth coming back for.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline (line-restaurants-lg.svg) reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. u1 scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_bg_photo
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave this empty and the hero keeps the flat dark color it has today — nothing changes until you choose a photo. The photo fills the whole hero and is cropped to fit, so its exact size does not matter; around 1920px on the long edge is plenty and anything bigger only slows the page. Light photos make white headlines hard to read, which is what the two overlay settings below are for. If you also set a background video below, this photo is what shows while the video loads and for anyone who has animation switched off.

fields.label: Background photo — phones
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_bg_photo_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the hero photo for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave empty and the main photo above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main photo is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or tighter version reads far better.

fields.label: Background photo — color
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_bg_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

fields.label: Background photo — movement
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_bg_photo_px
fields.instructions: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off. The dropdown this replaces offered 6, 10 and 16 as Subtle, Medium and Strong, so anything already set still reads exactly the same — you can now pick the values in between. 40 is the ceiling: the page itself stops there, so a larger number would do nothing. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

fields.label: Background photo — movement direction
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_bg_photo_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_overlay_color
fields.instructions: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

fields.label: Overlay strength
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_overlay_strength
fields.instructions: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_video_id
fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank to use the photo above, or the flat hero color if there is no photo. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls. The photo shows while the video loads, if the video is blocked, and for visitors who have switched off animation — so it is worth setting one as well.

fields.label: Video from
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_video_source
fields.instructions: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

fields.label: Section background
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_section_bg
fields.instructions: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below. ON A HERO THIS SITS BEHIND THE HERO PHOTO, so it only shows where that photo does not: with a background photo set, the photo covers the section edge to edge and this is hidden entirely. Use it on a hero with no photo, where it replaces the flat color.

fields.label: Background strength
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_section_bg_opacity
fields.instructions: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

fields.label: Background movement
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_section_bg_px
fields.instructions: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

fields.label: Background movement direction
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_section_bg_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

fields.label: Section background — phones
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_hero_section_bg_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Show the divider icon
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_show_divider
fields.instructions: The round badge that sits between this section and the one above it. Untick to remove just the badge — the section itself stays.

fields.label: Board & Brew — name
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_heading
fields.instructions: The brand name. Write & as a literal ampersand.

fields.label: Board & Brew — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_body_1
fields.instructions: Write & as a literal ampersand.
fields.default_value: San Diego's iconic sandwich shop. Board & Brew has been handcrafting sandos with fresh-baked bread and premium ingredients since before craft sandwiches were cool.

fields.label: Board & Brew — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_body_2
fields.instructions: Carries the live location count, so it needs editing whenever that changes. Write — as a literal em dash. CROSS-SECTION FACT — this number also appears in home-community -> Body copy second paragraph, and community-stats -> Stat 1 figure. Going ACF-editable REMOVED the check that used to catch a mismatch: it was three greppable strings in the repo, and it is now three database rows that nothing repo-side can compare. If you change one, change all three. (doc strings are per-field by construction, so this warning has to be repeated in each — there is nowhere on this project that can hold a cross-section fact.)
fields.default_value: 12 locations across San Diego and Orange County — each one a neighborhood staple.

fields.label: Board & Brew — button label
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_cta_label
fields.instructions: ~12 characters.

fields.label: Board & Brew — button link
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_cta_href
fields.instructions: Opens in a new tab; target/rel are in the markup.

fields.label: Odie's — name
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_odies_heading
fields.instructions: The brand name. CANONICAL FORM — Sean 2026-08-13: the official name carries the Co. at the end. Body copy is deliberately NOT swept to match; he asked that prose follow whatever copy is provided, and both forms are in use interchangeably. So this field is the one place the official name is asserted — change it here, leave the paragraphs alone.

fields.label: Odie's — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_odies_body_1
fields.instructions: Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: Oceanside's newest pizza obsession. Odie's Pizza Co. brings sourdough pies and radical vibes to the Southern California coast — think big slices, bold flavors, and a neighborhood vibe that makes you want to stick around.

fields.label: Odie's — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_odies_body_2
fields.instructions: Says more locations are coming, so it will need editing when they land.
fields.default_value: Our flagship is right in the heart of downtown Oceanside, and more locations are on the way.

fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_odies_cta_label
fields.instructions: ~12 characters.

fields.label: Odie's — button link
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_odies_cta_href
fields.instructions: Opens in a new tab; target/rel are in the markup.

fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_image
fields.instructions: The artwork in the Board & Brew panel. Landscape, around 800x550. An SVG logo lockup or a photo both work. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

Leave this off for a photo that fills its section edge to edge — there is nothing behind it to reveal.

fields.label: Board & Brew — image — drift direction
fields.name: brg_our_restaurants_brands_bnb_image_float_dir
fields.instructions: Which way this frame drifts. Set a large and a small photo in opposite directions.
